name: Oliva de Plasencia (Spain)
description: White field with a red stripe through the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Oliva de Plasencia (an olive branch, a bend and a wavy bend).
history: Municipal flag of Oliva de Plasencia; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Oliva de Plasencia arms — olive branch, bend and wavy bend
